description: This file defines the Customer entity class for the SalesManager e-commerce application, representing customer data including attributes, contacts, reviews, and related entities.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer in the e-commerce system, with fields for personal info, address, preferences, and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the customer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the customer.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Retrieves the customer's date of birth, cloning the Date object to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the customer's date of birth, cloning the Date object for safety.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the customer.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the email address of the customer.

methods.name: getNick
methods.description: Returns the nickname of the customer.

methods.name: setNick
methods.description: Sets the nickname of the customer.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the customer.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name associated with the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password of the customer.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the customer.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Indicates if the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: setAnonymous
methods.description: Sets whether the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Returns the list of product reviews made by the customer.

methods.name: setReviews
methods.description: Sets the list of product reviews made by the customer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the customer with a merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the customer.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery address information.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves the delivery address information.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing address information.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address information.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Associates the customer with a list of groups.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves the list of groups associated with the customer.

methods.name: getShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Gets the customer state list display flag.

methods.name: setShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Sets the customer state list display flag.

methods.name: getShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Gets the billing state list display flag.

methods.name: setShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Sets the billing state list display flag.

methods.name: getShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Gets the delivery state list display flag.

methods.name: setShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Sets the delivery state list display flag.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language of the customer.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language of the customer.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the customer attributes.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the gender of the customer.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Retrieves the gender of the customer.
